scope: Authored display adjacency and sequencing only. Parent anchors are justified by exact modeled endpoint links; no physical geography, source-transfer permission, or electrical hierarchy is established by placement.

composition.measurement: Use complete measured local module bounds, including labels, symbols, frame and terminals. Do not use guessed room dimensions.
composition.transform: Exactly one global translation per group; never translate graph descendants.
composition.lanes: Resolve lanes left to right by order. Reserve west/east external tracks before measuring lane separation.
composition.rows: Rows are stable logical sequence within each lane. Groups with identical laneId and row are a measured horizontal sibling band ordered by slot. Band width is sum of measured widths plus local gaps. Lane width is maximum band width.
composition.anchors: A band begins below its primary parent bounds and below the prior band in its lane. Branch groups use a reserved branch gap; close child groups use local gap. A row number is ordering, not a guessed y coordinate.
composition.alignment: The crushing-room adjacency overrides stagger: crushing-2/sw435-hv and crushing-1/hv share one top edge at row 3 in adjacent crushing lanes.
composition.routing: Route every external connection only between its listed exact terminals; use assigned track in reserved external corridor. Horizontal access uses inter-band gaps. Intermediate room interiors are unavailable. No route may treat an incidental crossing as a junction.
composition.referenceArea: Three unframed reference assemblies occupy reserved bands 8â€“10 below the completed SW435/HPGR branch in crushing-2. They have no electrical parent; lane reuse is display adjacency only.
composition.stagger: Reuse the stockpile column for train loading and water, and reuse the SW431 column for desands then screening. Independent branch order comes from explicit band rows, not graph traversal. Wide western LV siblings follow their motor boards in consecutive bands.
composition.fixedOrigins: Accepted rigid module origins are explicit. Module revisions do not reflow unrelated groups. Existing bands document the authored hierarchy; fixedModuleOrigins is authoritative for production compilation.
composition.waterHeader: Owner-requested right-hand OPF1-7/WT1/SW441 branch above SR411, with both station incoming supply runs lengthened. Confirmed OPF1-7 attachment retained.
